body:
FOR THE OWNER, in plain words (26 Nov 2026, from the lead and the advisor; nothing here needs you today). You asked for the server side: the admin pages and an installer with buttons. You were right: the pages are DRAWN, not built (only the page a friend sees when he taps an invitation link is built). Two new documents write down how it will be built, so that the buttons and the commands can never disagree: docs/35 (every optional thing) and docs/36 (installer, helper, admin site).
1. EVERY OPTIONAL THING WORKS THE SAME WAY (docs/35). Songs from YouTube, the higher-quality source, a music server you already run, the address for away from home, where backups go, friends on other servers, updating by itself: each has three states, 'Encore runs it', 'Yours' (you already run one: Encore asks for its address and never installs a second) or 'Off'. Before anything risky is switched on the page says the risk in plain words. Turning something off never deletes what was already made.
2. EVERY ACTION IS A BUTTON AND A COMMAND THAT DO THE SAME THING (docs/36). Update, back up, restore, change the away address: the page and the `encore` command call the same code, and a test makes them equal.
3. THE ADMIN PAGES ARE BUILT PEOPLE-FIRST. The page for people and invitations comes first because everything it needs already exists in the server; then Settings, Home (health in words), the first-run pages, then Backups/Updates/Away from home, which need the helper below.
4. A PAGE CAN NEVER CONTROL YOUR COMPUTER. The server may not start or stop containers. A small helper on your server computer does only a fixed list of things (update with a way back, back up, restore, change the away address); anything else is refused and logged. There is no Docker socket anywhere in Encore's containers.
5. THE INSTALLER WITH BUTTONS, FOR YOUR HOMELAB: a ready-made server image (a virtual machine file) that you upload in Proxmox's web page and start. It is built by running the very same install script, so the command and the buttons make the same installation, and a test compares them. Each server gets its own secrets the first time it starts. The VM's console shows the link and a one-time setup code, so only a person who controls the hypervisor can claim a new server. Still TO CHECK on your Proxmox version: that its web page accepts this file without a shell. Windows comes after, once yours has been walked.
6. IF YOU FORGET YOUR PASSWORD: a recovery key is shown once at the end of setup; `encore reset-owner` or the console menu of the VM resets it (being at the computer is the proof).
WHAT IS YOURS, LATER: when the changed pages are drawn (P3-22: restore as a button, update with its way back, add-on cards, the recovery key page) you will be asked to approve exactly those drawings, with exact steps. Nothing waits for it: the pages that did not change are built first.
